quote: I did not care what it was all about. All I wanted to know was how to live in it. Maybe if you found out how to live in it you learned from that what it was all about.
source: Ernest Hemingway, The Sun Also Rises, Book II, chapter 14 (Jake Barnes) (Charles Scribner’s Sons, 1926)
speaker: Jake Barnes

evidence.where: The Project Gutenberg text of the novel (etext 67138), made from the 1926 Scribner printing, read in place: the three sentences are consecutive in the first pages of chapter 14, after Perhaps as you went along you did learn something and before I wished Mike would not behave so terribly to Cohn
evidence.edition: The Sun Also Rises, Charles Scribner’s Sons, New York, 1926
evidence.locator: Book II, chapter 14, Jake awake and drunk in his room in Pamplona, thinking over paying for things

reason: Three consecutive sentences, word for word, in chapter 14 under Book II; Jake Barnes narrates, so he is named as the speaker. A reference line of the novel and a practice before theory line for the month. Not shipped, not banned; with the July carry of The Old Man and the Sea this makes two Hemingway lines in the year.
